_about: The pixel-art look of every floor (systems/floorArt.js draws it, no Phaser). pixel = screen pixels per art pixel. Each floor uses one of `variants` random layouts per tile colour (dungeons.json tileColors; tintShare = how much that colour tints the stones). Wall: stone bricks (brickH, brick widths), PILLARS (x centres in art pixels, width, capital/base), moss and vines from the top. Floor: old flagstones (row heights, stone widths) with dark dirt in the gaps, cracks, DIRT patches (count, radius), GRASS tufts (mostly near dirt and the walls), moss specks and pebbles, a shadow under the wall and darker side edges.

decor._about: Floor decorations (systems/floorArt.js drawDecor): counts per floor picture; stamps = rows of colour letters ('.' = nothing); shadow = how much darker the pixel under a stamp gets; cobwebs in the wall's top corners and beside the pillar capitals (webSize art px, webShare = how pale). The MOSSY RUIN look (user pick, session 55; cobwebs off: they sat under the top bar), + props (barrels, crates, a chest at fixed spots [stamp, x, y], plank piles) from the session-55 mix.

props._about: random per floor picture: `wall` = along the foot of the wall (zone x0, x1, y0, y1; y from the floor line), never within doorGap of the door's middle; `floor` = loose on the floor's right side (away from the knight); plankPiles = how many [min, max]

torch._about: The wall torches (squad screen) as pixel art: systems/torchArt.js. holder rows from the handle top down; flames = frames shown in turn (frameMs); glow = a few solid rings of warm light round the flame (glowSteps).

door._about: The door in the back wall (entities/Door.js): a stone arch (blocks, a lighter keystone), a dark wooden door of planks with two iron bands and rivets and a ring handle. Open = a black doorway.

art._about: The doors as pixel art (systems/doorArt.js) at the floor's pixel size: sizes in art pixels (y up from the floor line), colours of the wall's stone family.

big._about: The squad screen's dungeon ENTRANCE (user: 'very big door, very intimidating'): same parts, bigger, plus a skull keystone (skullPx = pixel size), portcullis spikes over the doorway (teeth), chains beside the arch, claw marks, bones on the floor and red eyes that blink in the dark when it opens. shakeMul / dustMul = a heavier slam.

anim._about: How the door opens (Door.open): rattleMs of shaking (rattlePx, rattles times) as it unlocks, then the halves swing open over swingMs (they speed up like a heavy door) to openScale, getting darker as they turn (shadeAlpha), bounce back by bounce and settle (bounceMs). On the hit: a thud shake (shakeMs, shakeIntensity), dust puffs at the foot (puffs each side) and dust falling from the arch (fallingDust). The doorOpen sound starts soundDelayMs after open() so its loud hit (about 200ms into the file) lands on the slam (user, session 50: it played early).
